title: Trump asks UFC chief Dana White to be his new press secretary: ‘please take the job’
snippet: US President Donald Trump announced on Saturday that he was offering a press secretary role to martial arts media magnate Dana White. “I am pleased to announce that the Great Dana White, a violent Fighter and Warrior, has been offered the job of Press Secretary of the United States,” Trump said on social media. “Dana, please take the job!” The White House has been without a press secretary since October 16 when Katie Zacharia left the position after less than a week on the job.
